decisions: The public landing page follows Figma nodes 53:1403 (desktop) and 52:1212 (mobile), using Hanken Grotesk for editorial typography, Plus Jakarta Sans for UI text, #1950D2 for primary actions, #000820/#12203D for trust surfaces, and committed Figma-exported imagery and icons.

Landing-page motion is intentionally restrained: only the hero offer stack, requester and provider mockups, typed request example, budget indicator, and user-initiated category image interactions animate; all motion is disabled when reduced motion is preferred.
